reason: B's main artifact is a working, keyboard-accessible, internally consistent simulation with proper reset and end states, a working mobile menu and 44px targets everywhere. A is a clean, zero-dependency static page but has nothing to operate, drops its navigation on phones and at 200% zoom, and has sub-44px targets. A would only win on maintainability (one file, no JS); evidence of B's script failing in common browsers (for example :has unsupported) would change my mind.
